kadapa.name: Kadapa
kadapa.highlights: Gandikota (The Grand Canyon of India), Belum Caves, Ameen Peer Dargah, and authentic Rayalaseema cuisine
kadapa.season: October through March offers pleasant, cool temperatures ideal for canyon walks and cave explorations.
itinerary: Arrive in Kadapa, visit Devuni Kadapa Sri Lakshmi Venkateswara Swamy Temple and the historic Ameen Peer Dargah
Full day excursion to Gandikota gorge (Grand Canyon of India), medieval Gandikota Fort, and Penna river viewpoint
Morning visit to Belum Caves stalactite chambers and Vontimitta Kodandarama Temple before departure

gandikota.name: Gandikota
gandikota.highlights: The majestic Penna river gorge (Grand Canyon of India), 13th-century fort, Raghunathaswamy Temple, and canyon camping
gandikota.season: October through February is the best season for canyon viewpoints and outdoor camping.
itinerary: Travel from Kadapa/Bangalore to Gandikota, check into canyon resort, and watch sunset over the Penna gorge
Explore Gandikota Fort, granary, Jama Masjid, and adventure trekking around the gorge perimeter
Morning visit to nearby Belum Caves before return travel

tirupati.name: Tirupati
tirupati.highlights: Sri Venkateswara Temple on Tirumala Hills, Silathoranam natural rock arch, Chandragiri Fort, and temple prasadam
tirupati.season: September through March offers pleasant weather for hill pilgrimage and fort exploration.
itinerary: Arrive in Tirupati, visit Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple and ISKCON temple in the foothills
Tirumala darshan pilgrimage, Akasa Ganga, and Silathoranam natural geological wonder
Visit Chandragiri heritage fort and museum before return travel

goa.name: Goa
goa.highlights: Coastal beaches, Portuguese heritage churches in Old Goa, and fresh coastal cuisine
goa.season: November to February offers dry, comfortable coastal weather and beach events.
itinerary: Old Goa heritage sites and Latin Quarter of Panaji
North Goa beaches (Anjuna, Vagator) and sunset cruise
South Goa relaxed coastal afternoon and spice plantation tour

delhi.name: Delhi
delhi.highlights: Historic Mughal architecture, museums, vibrant bazaars, and North Indian cuisine
delhi.season: October through March provides cool, pleasant sightseeing conditions.
itinerary: Red Fort, Chandni Chowk street food, and Jama Masjid
India Gate, Humayun Tomb, and Qutub Minar
National Museum, Lodhi Gardens, and Connaught Place

mumbai.name: Mumbai
mumbai.highlights: Marine Drive, Gateway of India, heritage architecture, and coastal nightlife
mumbai.season: November through February is the best period with low humidity and mild breezes.
itinerary: Gateway of India, Colaba Causeway, and Marine Drive evening promenade
Elephanta Caves boat tour and Kala Ghoda art precinct
Bandra promenade, Mount Mary, and coastal street food

bangalore.name: Bangalore
bangalore.highlights: Cubbon Park gardens, craft microbreweries, tech hubs, and pleasant weather
bangalore.season: Pleasant throughout the year; October through February is exceptionally mild.
itinerary: Cubbon Park, Bengaluru Palace, and Vidhana Soudha
Lalbagh Botanical Gardens and traditional breakfast in Basavanagudi
Indiranagar boutiques, cafe hopping, and craft food tour

hyderabad.name: Hyderabad
hyderabad.highlights: Charminar, Golconda Fort, Nizami heritage, and authentic Hyderabadi biryani
hyderabad.season: October through March offers temperate weather for exploring outdoor monuments.
itinerary: Charminar, Mecca Masjid, and Laad Bazaar pearl markets
Golconda Fort guided tour and Qutb Shahi Tombs
Chowmahalla Palace and an authentic Nizami dining experience

jaipur.name: Jaipur
jaipur.highlights: Pink City palaces, Amber Fort, Rajasthani royal history, and vibrant handicrafts
jaipur.season: October through March is ideal for desert and fort exploration.
itinerary: Amber Fort elephant viewpoints and Jal Mahal
City Palace, Jantar Mantar observatory, and Hawa Mahal
Local bazaars (Johari, Bapu) and traditional Rajasthani thali

kochi.name: Kochi
kochi.highlights: Chinese fishing nets, Fort Kochi heritage, spice warehouses, and backwater access
kochi.season: September through March brings cool coastal breezes and cultural festivals.
itinerary: Fort Kochi walking tour, St. Francis Church, and Chinese Fishing Nets
Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace) and Jewish Synagogue
Kerala backwaters day cruise and seafood dining

chennai.name: Chennai
chennai.highlights: Marina Beach, Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Carnatic music, and South Indian coffee
chennai.season: November to February is cooler and pleasant for coastal walks.
itinerary: Kapaleeshwarar Temple and historic Mylapore cultural walk
Government Museum, San Thome Cathedral, and Marina Beach evening
Day excursion to Mahabalipuram shore temples

kolkata.name: Kolkata
kolkata.highlights: Victoria Memorial, Howrah Bridge, colonial architecture, and Bengali sweets
kolkata.season: October to March offers mild weather and colorful festive atmospheres.
itinerary: Victoria Memorial, St. Paul Cathedral, and Maidan walk
Howrah Bridge, Kumartuli artisan lane, and riverside ghats
Park Street culinary institutions and Indian Museum

pondicherry.name: Pondicherry
pondicherry.highlights: French Quarter colonial villas, Promenade Beach, Auroville, and seaside cafes
pondicherry.season: October to March offers dry, breezy coastal days.
itinerary: French Quarter heritage walk, Notre Dame des Anges, and Promenade Beach sunset
Auroville Matrimandir visit, organic farm tour, and Serenity Beach
Paradise Beach boat ride and French bakery hopping

ooty.name: Ooty
ooty.highlights: Nilgiri toy train, botanical gardens, tea estates, and panoramic Doddabetta Peak
ooty.season: March to June for spring blooms; October to February for cool mist.
itinerary: Nilgiri Mountain Railway ride and Government Botanical Garden
Doddabetta Peak viewpoint, tea factory tour, and Ooty Lake boating
Pykara waterfalls and lake excursion

shimla.name: Shimla
shimla.highlights: The Ridge, Mall Road, colonial heritage, and Himalayan mountain panoramas
shimla.season: March to June for pleasant weather; December to February for snow experiences.
itinerary: The Ridge, Christ Church, and Mall Road pedestrian promenade
Jakhoo Temple scenic trek and ropeway
Kufri alpine valley viewpoints and pine forest walk

dubai.name: Dubai
dubai.highlights: Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, desert safari, futuristic architecture, and luxury marinas
dubai.season: November through March provides comfortable outdoor temperatures and desert activities.
itinerary: Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa observation deck, and Dubai Mall fountains
Evening desert safari with dune bashing and traditional dinner
Dubai Marina yacht cruise, JBR beach, and Museum of the Future

singapore.name: Singapore
singapore.highlights: Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands, Chinatown, and world-class hawker food
singapore.season: Warm and tropical year-round; pack light clothing and prepare for brief showers.
itinerary: Marina Bay Sands skyway, Gardens by the Bay, and Cloud Forest dome
Chinatown heritage walk, Maxwell Hawker Centre, and Little India
Sentosa Island beaches or world-class Singapore Botanic Gardens

bangkok.name: Bangkok
bangkok.highlights: Grand Palace, Wat Pho, river express boats, night markets, and Thai street food
bangkok.season: November through February is the coolest and driest period in Thailand.
itinerary: Grand Palace, Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha), and Wat Arun across the river
Chao Phraya river cruise, Chatuchak or IconSiam, and street food tour
Jim Thompson House, Lumpini Park, and rooftop panoramic dining

bali.name: Bali
bali.highlights: Ubud rice terraces, coastal beach clubs, water temples, and volcanic viewpoints
bali.season: April through October provides sunny, dry weather ideal for beaches and exploring.
itinerary: Ubud cultural center, Tegallalang rice terraces, and Monkey Forest
Uluwatu cliff temple and Kecak fire dance overlooking the ocean
Seminyak beach clubs, coastal sunset, and water sports at Nusa Dua

paris.name: Paris
paris.highlights: Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Seine riverbank, Montmartre, and French culinary arts
paris.season: April to June and September to October offer mild weather with manageable crowds.
itinerary: Eiffel Tower, Champ de Mars, and Seine sunset river cruise
Louvre Museum, Tuileries Garden, and Champs-Elysees to Arc de Triomphe
Montmartre, Sacre-Coeur basilica, and bohemian cafe culture

london.name: London
london.highlights: Westminster Abbey, Tower of London, British Museum, West End, and Thames walks
london.season: May through September brings pleasant temperatures and long daylight hours.
itinerary: Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, and London Eye
Tower of London, Tower Bridge, and Borough Market culinary stalls
British Museum, Covent Garden, and an evening West End performance

tokyo.name: Tokyo
tokyo.highlights: Shibuya Crossing, Senso-ji temple, futuristic districts, gardens, and authentic ramen
tokyo.season: March to May for cherry blossoms; October to November for clear autumn skies.
itinerary: Asakusa Senso-ji temple, Tokyo Skytree, and Akihabara tech hub
Meiji Shrine, Harajuku Takeshita Street, and Shibuya Crossing
Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden, teamLab digital art, and Ginza dining

kuala lumpur.name: Kuala Lumpur
kuala lumpur.highlights: Petronas Twin Towers, Batu Caves, Jalan Alor street food, and heritage mosques
kuala lumpur.season: Warm and tropical year-round; May to July offers slightly lower precipitation.
itinerary: Petronas Twin Towers skybridge and KLCC Park fountains
Batu Caves limestone temple and Merdeka Square heritage district
Jalan Alor night food market and Bukit Bintang shopping boulevard

colombo.name: Colombo
colombo.highlights: Galle Face Green, Gangaramaya Temple, Pettah markets, and Ceylon tea lounges
colombo.season: December through March offers the driest and most pleasant coastal weather.
itinerary: Galle Face Green seaside walk and Old Dutch Hospital precinct
Gangaramaya Temple and Independence Memorial Hall
Pettah market street walk and colonial beachfront dinner

kathmandu.name: Kathmandu
kathmandu.highlights: Durbar Square, Boudhanath Stupa, Swayambhunath, and Himalayan mountain vistas
kathmandu.season: October to December offers clear Himalayan skies and crisp pleasant temperatures.
itinerary: Kathmandu Durbar Square and historic old alleys
Boudhanath Stupa and Pashupatinath Temple
Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) and Thamel craft markets

male.name: Male
male.highlights: Overwater bungalows, turquoise coral lagoons, world-class diving, and private atolls
male.season: December through April offers sunny skies and calm turquoise seas.
itinerary: Speedboat arrival to private resort island and sunset overwater dinner
Coral reef snorkeling and manta ray marine exploration
Sandbank picnic and sunset dolphin cruise
